# Permission matrix (generated; do not edit by hand)

Generated by `backend/scripts/generate_permission_matrix.py` from `backend/app/core/permissions.py` and `backend/tests/golden/endpoint_matrix.json`. Both are checked by tests, so this document cannot drift from the code.

Symbols: ✔ allowed, – refused. Guests (not signed in) hold only `incident.report`, `incident.track` and `public.read`.
Scope notes: `*.assigned` = only the officer's own team's missions; `*.own` = only the user's own records.
